summary_text: On 2026-04-14 (weekday), the user ordered fresh fruit items in the evening: one SUPERPLUM Sindhura Mango and one Watermelon Kiran. This evening timing aligns with the population baseline, where evening accounts for 30.27% of activity, slightly below the morning share (32.46%) but higher than afternoon (25.26%) and night (12.02%). The products are fresh fruits typically used for immediate consumption or hydration. This is a single observation from one date; it is not yet established whether this represents a stable preference for these specific brands or varieties, or if the user typically buys fruit at different times of day.
